name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-health
description: Medical texts in your memory, from public sources: rare diseases (Orphanet, CC BY 4.0, English, French, Spanish), mental health topics (NIMH, public domain), WHO fact sheets (English, French, Spanish), the MeSH medical vocabulary (U.S. National Library of Medicine) and open-access research articles (PubMed Central, licence shown per article). Each text keeps its source, its date and its licence, in your knowledge folder and in one Memory Pack per source. It quotes texts and gives no medical advice.

Each text keeps its source, its date and its licence, in your knowledge folder and in one Memory Pack per source. It quotes texts and gives no medical advice.

descriptionI18n.es: Textos médicos en tu memoria, de fuentes públicas: enfermedades raras (Orphanet, CC BY 4.0, inglés, francés, español), temas de salud mental (NIMH, dominio público), notas descriptivas de la OMS (inglés, francés, español), el vocabulario médico MeSH (Biblioteca Nacional de Medicina de EE. UU.) y artículos de investigación en acceso abierto (PubMed Central, licencia mostrada por artículo). Cada texto conserva su fuente, su fecha y su licencia, en tu carpeta de conocimientos y en un Memory Pack por fuente. Cita textos y no da ningún consejo médico.

agentActions.summary: Say what MnemoHealth shows and holds: the domain on screen, the job running, what is already in memory per source
agentActions.details: inMemory has one line per source and language: entries in the vault, failed, skipped (no text at the source), and where an Add all run stopped. onScreen is what the last gesture said. Nothing is added while library is not read or vault is not ready.

agentActions.summary: List the domains and their sources (Orphanet, NIMH, WHO, MeSH, PubMed Central), with languages and licences
agentActions.details: A catalogue source (orphanet, nimh, who) loads whole; a searched source (mesh, pmc) is loaded by words, one page at a time.

agentActions.summary: Show one domain's screen, as a click on its tile does

domain.description: The domain: rare diseases, mental health, WHO fact sheets, vocabulary, research

agentActions.summary: Load a source's list (a catalogue) or search it (MeSH, PubMed Central), as its Load or Search button does
agentActions.details: The domain is shown and the list read on screen. A catalogue takes no query: narrow it with entries. A searched source needs query, and offset pages its results. Answers the count and the first 30 entries; past 45 s it answers running: call status, then entries.

lang.description: The language to read it in, the one on screen when absent (orphanet and who: en, fr, es; the others en)

query.description: Words to search MeSH or PubMed Central for

offset.description: Where a page of search results starts, 0 when absent

agentActions.summary: Show the next or the previous page of a PubMed Central search, as the Next and Previous buttons do (MeSH answers in one page)
agentActions.details: Pages the search on screen with its own words; refused FIRST_PAGE before the first page and LAST_PAGE after the last.

lang.description: The language of the list, the one on screen when absent

agentActions.summary: Read a source in another language, as its language menu does (Orphanet and WHO: en, fr, es; the others en only)
agentActions.details: Shows the source's domain and switches the language on screen; a list already loaded in that language comes back, otherwise call loadList.

agentActions.summary: Go back to the home screen with its domain tiles, as the Back button does
Page through a loaded list, with each entry's state (in memory or not)

lang.description: The language of the list, the one on screen when absent

query.description: Part of a title (or an exact id), to narrow the list

limit.description: How many to return, 30 when absent

offset.description: How many to skip, 0 when absent

agentActions.summary: Put one entry of a loaded list into memory, by its title or its id, as its Add button does
agentActions.details: The text is read from its source, filed in the source's Memory Pack and copied to the knowledge folder. Answers once the entry is in memory; WRITE_FAILED when it did not get there. PubMed Central is refused: its licences are chosen by the person on screen. Past 45 s it answers running.

lang.description: The language of the list, the one on screen when absent

entryId.description: The entry's title as the person says it (« mucoviscidose », « Marfan syndrome »), or its id from loadList or entries

agentActions.summary: Put a whole loaded catalogue, or a whole page of search results, into memory, as the Add all button does
agentActions.details: Starts and answers at once: it runs on screen while MnemoHealth stays open; a catalogue resumes where it last stopped. Call status for progress, stop to stop. PubMed Central is refused.

lang.description: The language of the list, the one on screen when absent

agentActions.summary: Stop the list or import running, as the Stop button does; what reached memory stays

agentGuide: Name an entry the way the person says it (« la mucoviscidose », « anxiety »): add finds it by its title in the loaded list, and an id still works. Several matches are refused AMBIGUOUS with their titles and ids: pick one and call add again with the id. NO_ENTRY lists titles that exist.

Spoken domains: rare diseases / maladies rares = orphanet (domain rare), mental health / santé mentale = nimh (mental), WHO / OMS fact sheets = who (who), medical vocabulary / vocabulaire = mesh (vocab), research articles / recherche = pmc (research).

To look at something: openDomain shows a domain, showHome goes back, setLanguage switches a source's language, loadList loads a catalogue or searches MeSH and PubMed Central by words, turnPage pages a search.
To put one text in memory: loadList the source first (a catalogue loads whole), then add with the title, in the same steps. addAll is a long run; stop stops it.
It quotes texts and gives no medical advice: never answer a health question from these actions, only show, find and file.
